brief:
An American proposal would allow Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to remain in office even if he loses upcoming elections, according to Ma'an news agency. The scenario envisions a political arrangement that would bypass the standard transfer of power following electoral defeat. Details of the proposal's specific mechanics and backing within U.S. administration circles were not elaborated.

The revelation comes amid ongoing political tensions in Israel and international scrutiny of Netanyahu's position as he faces multiple legal challenges and coalition pressures at home.
title: U.S. scenario would keep Netanyahu in power despite election loss
